column3: Miyabi-chan
U-Uh... hahahaha...
That indecisive attitude of yours is irritating.
If you are a man, have some confidence.
S-Sorry, it's true that my attitude may not be manly.
Hmph... It's good that you get it.
But...
If you don't play that godly game... you're wasting 1/3 of your life!
T-This girl... She disregards others' feelings and says this...!
To an examinee like me, taking away my studying time is what's going to waste my life!
That tournament as well, Kirino wanted me to take part in and so I went for her sake...
Didn't I do special training for a while for the Siscaly tournament?!
Gn...
H-How was that... It's a very sound reason!
But, but, but! Do you think that's an excuse?!
Eh?!
Right... Reasoning won't get through this girl...
To think you're delaying to play the godly game... You're really weird.
Even if you say that...
Well, I'll acknowledge that you took part in the tournament.
I'm not sure, but it seems the situation has been alleviated...
It shall proceed like that for now...
G-Gnnn...
Kirino?
This just won't do! Unforgivable!
It's true that "SisXSis" may be a godly game to you.
But however! To impose those preferences onto others is-
I-It's certainly entertaining! Miyabi-chan's route made you cry, right?
Even if just a little, just give Rinko-rin route's a try!
Why are you that desperate?
B-Because...
Hm?
I-It doesn't matter, does it?! It has a good story, so I'm just recommending it!
Even so, she's being too desperate...
If it's come to this....
Silence is golden.
At times like this, you must stick to this idiom.
...Why are you staying silent? It's gross.
...It's fine; I don't mind.
Even when we did it together, you didn't want to, right?
If the neighbors heard this, they'd totally misunderstand...
It's all a lie... Even though you said "If you're not here, I'll die"...
Wha... Y-You... You're bringing that up now....?
I don't know if she's doing it on purpose, but it's much more effective to harass than yelling!
Th-That's not true. What I said to you at that time- Everything is true. If I had the time, I would play "SisSis" right away.
...Really?
Yeah, really.
Hmm, I see. Then you have until tomorrow to complete it.
Like I said, that's impossible!
Then it really was a lie!
What can I do--!
